name: UK strikes & disruption
value: Consultant strike paused; Tube strikes 26 Nov
summary: BMA paused the 25–26 Nov consultant strike on 11 Nov for talks; RMT London Tube strikes start 26 Nov
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that consultants in England had called off the strike planned for 25–26 Nov to enter formal negotiations with the government, warning further action could follow if talks stall (ITV News). The RMT has set eight 24-hour London Underground strikes, the first from noon on 26 Nov and the rest between 17 Dec and 25 Feb (IanVisits). With no national-scale strike or nationwide disruption due, the signal stays Normal.
for_you: London Underground users face disruption from noon on 26 Nov; Transport for London publishes travel updates. Planned NHS care in England on 25–26 Nov is no longer affected by consultant action.
rubric_hit: Normal: no national-scale strike or major infrastructure disruption due before 26 Nov; Tube strikes are regional

sources.title: ITV News — Consultant doctors call off strike after 'constructive' talks over pay, BMA says
IanVisits — Tube strikes announced in the weeks up to Christmas

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
